notes.title: Hot-fix 1.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194469/424fe21e141cca3ae53c1057d40694f6ac575a12.png

 Added the ability to mine firewood. Now you will need wood to make a fire in the stove.
 Fixed bug with non-functional button "Escape" in the pause menu. 
 Now, after some time - the fire in the stove will go out.
 The pause menu can now be closed by pressing the "Escape" button

notes.title: Hot-fix 1.1
notes.content:
Did some vegetation optimization to reduce the load on the video card.
 Fixed bug with incorrect display of item/resource billboards.
 Fixed bug with mouse in main menu and at game start, when it was necessary to click the mouse once to bring the mouse into action.

notes.title: Hot-fix 1.0
notes.content:
Added a lot of small trees in the empty places in the location, now the forest looks richer.
 Added markers to resources such as berries, mushrooms, sticks and items in the hut, which become visible when you approach them. This will make it easier to find resources in the forest.
 The color of the character marker in the map menu has been changed to red. It is now faster to determine your location.

notes.title: Hot-fix 0.9
notes.content:
Reduced the size of the collision of fallen trees. Now the character can step over them
 Increased the size of the resource model such as a stick
 Added clouds to the mountains in the background
 Increased the amount of healing plants on the level
 Changed colors of icons on the world map
 Disabled character walking in the world map menu
 Fixed bug with getting stuck in a bottleneck on the porch side of the workbench
 The saturation effect of berries has been reduced by a third. During the day, you can fill half of the hunger scale with berries.
 Crickets sound at night has been made quieter
 Added new sounds of day and night birds, as well as the sound of rustling bushes at night.
 Slightly increased brightness of night lights
 Slightly increased duration of night and day.
 texture of rabbit model now does not look plassmassy
 paths now have noticeably smaller trails
 New vegetation added
 Lowered satiety consumption. Now hunger does not come so quickly.

notes.title: Hot-fix 0.8
notes.content: Fixed bug with white screen instead of splash screen in main menu.

notes.title: Hot-fix 0.7
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the workbench light would not go out after sleeping
Added FOV setting
Added mouse sensitivity setting
Added map of the game world.

notes.title: Hot-fix 0.6
notes.content:
Fixed a bug in the tooltip menu
 Fixed a bug with additional menus appearing after reopening the pause menu.
 Fixed bug with the behavior of the AI rabbits. Now if they ran away from their habitat during the chase, they will return to their habitat.

notes.title: Hot-fix 0.5
notes.content:
The length of the day is slightly longer
 Adjusted weather changes
 Fixed day counter
 A temporary sleep ban is now introduced after sleeping. Now you have to wait about a quarter of the game day before you can sleep again.

notes.title: Hot-fix 0.4
notes.content:
Increased chance of catching fish
 Added new text notifications for items
 Added loading screen
 Fixed some minor bugs
 Added day counter in the rest menu
 Added action screen when harvesting rabbit meat
 Added sound when gathering rabbit meat

notes.title: Hot-fix 0.3
notes.content: Fixed the bug with saving the weather

notes.title: Hot-fix 0.2
notes.content: Fixed bug with saving resource storage.

notes.title: Hot-fix 0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

 Increased food storage capacity
 Inventory capacity increased
 Fixed bug with food/resources respawn
 Fixed a bug that prohibited eating berries the next day
 Increased the number of berries you can eat in one day.

notes.title: Small release hot-fix!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I read the player feedback and based on that information, released a small update.

 Added a compass to make it easier for players to navigate.
 The likelihood of rainy weather after sleep has been reduced.
 Satiety consumption after sleep has been reduced.
